meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会安装 OneCLI,把 .env 里的 Anthropic 等密钥搬进 Agent Vault,之后由网关在请求时注入,智能体看不到原始密钥;同时还会重新构建并重启服务、验证配置是否成功。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 更新把 OneCLI 变成破坏性变更之后,或首次需要从头搭建 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI 并迁移 .env 里的密钥。
say.note: 它会安装网关并把现有凭证转入保险库。

say.text: 更新后 OneCLI 没生效,重新配置一下。
say.note: Claude 会检查现状并询问是否重装配置。

say.text: 把我的 OPENAI_API_KEY 也迁到保险库。
say.note: 它会询问哪些容器凭证要迁移,然后处理。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI, sets up the Agent Vault gateway, and moves existing .env credentials (e.g. Anthropic keys) into the vault. After setup, credentials are injected at request time so agents never see raw keys; the skill also rebuilds and restarts the service and verifies the integration.
howto.when_en: Triggers after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or whenever OneCLI needs to be set up from scratch.

say_en.text: Set up OneCLI and migrate my .env credentials.
say_en.note: Installs the gateway and moves existing secrets into the vault.

say_en.text: OneCLI didn't work after the update. Reconfigure it.
say_en.note: Checks current state and asks whether to reinstall.

say_en.text: Also move my OPENAI_API_KEY to the vault.
say_en.note: Asks which container credentials to migrate, then moves them.
